_what: How a change between two points in a code host becomes a picture and, when asked, one comment of ours on the pull request (src/change-picture.mjs). Each entry of `forges` is a code host written as DATA: the connector tools that read the change and write comments (`tools`, names of the connection's operations), how a connector answer maps to the generic comment (`comment`: dotted paths), which surface capability record the comment is written for (`surface`, src/surface-compose.json), and how the author of our comments is found (`whoami`). `marker` is the hidden text that makes a comment ours (it is a link-reference line, which no reader draws); `compare_pages_most` and `page_size` bound how much of a change is read; `peek_files` is how many files the model-input listing names before it says how many more. `words` are plain.

words.heading: What this change touches
words.no_picture: The picture is not attached here because no image address was given.
words.bounded_note: Nothing left this machine to make the picture: only file names and counts were read.

errors.UNKNOWN_FORGE: No code host of that name is described.
errors.BAD_DOCUMENT: The graph document you gave is not valid: {first}
errors.NO_FILES: The two points have no changed files between them.
